gp.heading: Cost of sales and gross profit
gp.text:

The change in cost of sales for the year ended December 31, 2024 was primarily driven by the following:

• Purchasing savings, partially offset by higher sales volume, mix and net new business, decreased cost of sales by approximately $19 million.

The Company is a global product leader in clean and efficient technology solutions for combustion, hybrid and electric vehicles.
